principle: One navigation list, one presentation per viewport, owned by the actor shell. CLIENT SCREENS MUST NEVER SHOW INTAKE.

implementation.shell: MigrationShell (AioMigrationKit.tsx): environment → header → AioDesktopSidebar (staff) → main → AioStaffDock (staff)
implementation.items: STAFF_NAV: HOME · INTAKE (current) · FILING · REPORTS · MORE — the same list feeds the dock and the sidebar
implementation.sourceOrder: header, sidebar, main, dock — keyboard focus reaches the header search first, then the sidebar, then the work
implementation.back: BACK (founder request 2026-10-08; not drawn in the authority set): a chevron button at the left of the header, before the lockup, on every screen but the intake root, the client's first step (HERE'S WHAT AIO ALREADY KNOWS) and the arrival screen. It opens the step before the current one in its branch (MigrationStudioPage PREVIOUS, ClientOfficeReviewPage previousStep) and keeps the open client. Phone: full-height 70u target, lockup moves right (76u root family, 78u existing family). Tablet/desktop: 40px button, first item of the header row.

MOBILE.header: authority header (lockup, search, bell, avatar, identity, chevron) — locked

TABLET.header: 77px compact full-width bar: lockup · divider · CLIENT MIGRATION · search icon · bell · avatar · identity (fixed 92px slot) · chevron
TABLET.nav: full-width touch dock, 113px, five equal columns, active INTAKE tile 124×75 dark with gold label — the tablet master keeps the dock (no mobile assumption: sized for touch, not the phone's absolute coordinates)

DESKTOP.header: 68px full-width utility bar: lockup · divider · AIO OFFICE / CLIENT MIGRATION · search field (Search clients, migrations, or help…) · bell · rule · avatar · identity · chevron
DESKTOP.nav: persistent left sidebar 138px from the header to the bottom: HOME, INTAKE (active: dark tile, gold label, 5px gold edge), FILING, REPORTS, MORE
DESKTOP.dock: none — the phone dock never renders on desktop
DESKTOP.search: submits to /office/migration/existing?q=<term> — the existing-client finder filtered by the term (intake searches clients)

TABLET.header: 77px bar: lockup · divider · CLIENT ACTIVATION · search icon · bell · avatar · identity

DESKTOP.header: 68px bar: lockup · divider · CLIENT OFFICE / CLIENT ACTIVATION · search icon · bell · avatar · identity
DESKTOP.nav: none — no sidebar, no dock, no INTAKE, no staff controls, no /office links

CLIENT.ARRIVAL: header without tools (avatar + identity only) over the full environment

transformations.MOBILE→TABLET: absolute authority header → flex bar with workspace context; dock re-laid as five equal touch columns across the full width (no absolute item coordinates)
transformations.TABLET→DESKTOP: dock → persistent sidebar; search icon → search field; context gains the AIO OFFICE line; a rule separates notifications from the profile
